messages:
alex: FYI — I'm kicking off the deprecation notice for the legacy permission bundles (rbac-v1) tomorrow morning. Need a quick sync on console affordances and API compatibility.
priya: cool. what's the migration story for tenant admins? do we provide a one-click mapping or just docs + scripts?
alex: plan is two-pronged: in-console mapping suggestions for simple cases, and a bulk-migrate CLI tool for large tenants. mapping logic lives in the access-service.
noah: for the in-console flow, we should avoid auto-applying anything without confirmation. suggests: show inferred role -> allow edit -> require checkbox to confirm.
jane: +1 on explicit confirmation. also needs an audit log entry per mapping so security teams can review changes.
sara: telemetry request: surface the number of inferred mappings that were edited vs accepted. that's a key regression signal.
priya: agree. also add a metric for mapping failures (e.g., unmatched entitlements) so we can follow up with docs.
alex: good — we'll add these to the rollout checklist. UI notes: add an inline help tooltip that explains why inference made that suggestion. short copy only.
noah: UX nit: if tenant has >500 principals, we need pagination and a progress state for bulk-migrate. don't block the console.
jane: what about quotas? if bulk migration triggers a lot of requests to access-service, we should throttle and surface async progress.
alex: ops: would prefer we queue the jobs into the existing migration-worker and rate-limit by tenant. status bubbled into console via background tasks.
priya: API-deprecation detail — we'll keep the old API for 30 days after notice, but the CLI will default to new endpoints and emit a warning log.
sara: can we add a regression alert tied to sample prompts/evals? earlier changes caused permission regressions that only showed up in prod.
noah: add a canary rollout: 5% of tenants first, then 25% after 48h. we should instrument per-tenant failures and rollback thresholds.
jane: rollback threshold: if more than 0.5% of mapping attempts fail for canary tenants in 1h, auto-pause rollout.
alex: agreed. I'll add the threshold to the runbook. who's on-call for the first 72h of rollout?
priya: i'll take first 24h, noah next 24h, jane last 24h — will hand off in #eng-oncall.
deploy-bot: Reminder: deprecation notice email scheduled for 2025-12-02 09:00 UTC.
sara: one more ask — in the permissions editor, show an "effective preview" after mapping so admins can quickly scan what principals will gain/lose. small table + highlighted risky grants.
noah: implement as a diff overlay: left current, right proposed. highlight new broad grants in red.
jane: also ensure service-accounts are excluded from auto-mapping unless explicitly opted in.
alex: noted. I'll push an RFC PR with the flow and mockups today. please comment on the UX and the telemetry bullets before EOD. :thumbsup:
priya: will review.
sara: lgtm — added to monitoring board and created dashboards stub for mapping-accept-rate and mapping-edit-rate.
alex: thanks — if we catch the edge cases early we can avoid support churn.
priya: quick question — do we need legal sign-off for the notice copy?
jane: legal reviewed the template last week, just need final send list.
alex: ok wrapping — RFC link: https://go/redwood/rfc/rbac-migrate-v1 (draft). comments welcome.
priya: thanks, closing loop on my side.
noah: thanks all.
